items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cornelius Cornell, he was a trumpet player from Saginaw, Michigan. Anyway, Jimmy Parker was in the band. Thad and I were in the band.

ctx.x: Cornelius Cornell, if you can believe that! Cornelius Cornell, he was a trumpet player from Saginaw, Michigan. Anyway, Jimmy Parker was in the band. Thad and I were in the band. We played The Cotton Club in Cincinnati. You could go to a restaurant, owned by Afro Americans there, to get a complete dinner, including dessert, salad and dessert, for $.40.
